text: Toronto and East York Community Council, at its meeting of October 17, 2017 adopted Item TE27.56 entitled, "Installation/Removal of On-Street Parking Restrictions – Various Streets in Wards 20 and 28" which requested authorization to implement taxi stands on Portland Street, Brant Street, Wellington Street, and Widmer Street. This was to accommodate additional taxi stand spaces in the vicinity of the King Street Transit Pilot. Based on field observations and in consultation with the Toronto Police Service and the Councillor's Office, Transportation Services recommends that the taxi stand that was recently introduced on Brant Street be removed, which requires a re-opening of TE27.56. This staff report concerns a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or…

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1.
